description: Allow this plugin's own CLI invocations without a prompt (PreToolUse), and nudge toward gh-security resolve-alerts when a Bash (or backgrounded BashOutput) command's output carries a GitHub vulnerability notice or package manager audit findings (PostToolUse). Check at session start that the tools this plugin needs are present (SessionStart).

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\\ngh-security: ⚠️ node not found on PATH"}\n'; exit 0; fi; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.ts"; exit 0
